high_level_description: The image is a two-panel meme that provides interesting trivia about the character Buzz Lightyear from the animated movie "Toy Story." The top panel contains text explaining that Buzz Lightyear was originally going to be called "Lunar Larry" but was changed to honor real-life astronaut Buzz Aldrin. The bottom panel shows two images side by side for comparison. On the left side of the bottom panel, there is a sketch of an early concept design for Buzz Lightyear.
